## What changed and why

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and any relevant issue.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. For device-dependent changes, include
the model and firmware, what was tested with hardware, and what remains
unverified. For UI changes, include screenshots when useful.

## Contributor checks

- [ ] I reviewed [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior where needed, using synthetic fixtures.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any changed setup, behavior or limitations.
- [ ] This change includes no credentials, private captures or unlicensed third-party files.
- [ ] Any device write used during validation was intentional, and restoration results are described above.
